decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in both years and is cheap to maintain because it runs on the firm's existing market-data databases, so the option is worth keeping open while its value develops.

The calculator was downgraded from its own page to a mention, and sibling tariff tools were already pruned, which signals weakening prospects; but the marginal cost of keeping it on the shared data platform is low, so it stays for now.

The area definition tool has also lost its own page, but it likely serves as a supporting component for the remaining location-based tools and costs little to keep, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
